description: With a live seat and zero bundles, exercise both picker actions on migrated PostgreSQL. Check first page, total, search for the other client and lookup by mixed IDs.
An unrelated assignment or an applicable bundle with no client read rule leaves the seat boundary intact. A client read rule selecting a different client gives an empty intersection.
After revocation a fresh picker request returns no clients. Ordinary unrestricted MSP staff in the same tenant can still select both clients.
Run the existing client/contact authorization integration suite and authorization package tests, including list/detail parity and the unrestricted fast path.
